rationale: Janssen et al. (2022) reported a discovery cohort of eight individuals with de novo putative loss-of-function (pLoF) variants in TAF4 presenting with a neurodevelopmental disorder designated T4NDD (OMIM #620450). The core phenotypic features identified in the cohort specifically include intellectual disability, abnormal behavior, and facial dysmorphisms. While the abstract in the provided text confirms the cohort size of n=8 and these exact core domains as common manifestations, full individual-by-individual clinical tabulations would require the full paper table to resolve exact numerators.

evidence.text: Janssen et al. present a discovery cohort of eight individuals, each carrying de novo putative loss-of-function (pLoF) variants in TAF4 and expressing phenotypes consistent with a neurodevelopmental disorder (T4NDD), where common features include intellectual disability, abnormal behavior, and facial dysmorphisms.

source.title: De novo putative loss‐of‐function variants in TAF4 are associated with a neuro‐developmental disorder
source.quote: We here present a cohort of eight individuals, each carrying de novo putative loss-of-function (pLoF) variants in TAF4 and expressing phenotypes consistent with a neuro-developmental disorder (NDD). Common features include intellectual disability, abnormal behavior, and facial dysmorphisms.

evidence.text: Staykova et al. (2024) contextualize pathogenic variants in TFIID complex subunits, noting that pathogenic variants in TAF4 cause TAF4-related neurodevelopmental disorder (T4NDD).

new_directions.question_text: What is the exact penetrance and specific granular HPO breakdown of facial dysmorphisms, behavioral features, and neurodevelopmental milestones across an expanded multi-center cohort of TAF4 pLoF cases?
new_directions.rationale: The initial cohort defines the core triad across eight individuals, but larger international registries are needed to evaluate exact penetrance percentages, negative predictive findings, and variant-specific genotype-phenotype correlations.
